source.name: Rapyd: A New Era in Israeli Basketball: Maccabi Tel Aviv and Rapyd Sign Groundbreaking 7-Year Sponsorship Agreement
source.quote: and Rapyd’s logo will proudly appear on the front of the players’ jerseys
source.note: Title/main sponsor since July 2025: the team plays as Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv. The Rapyd wordmark sits under the chest number on the 2026/27 home jersey in the club's launch photos (23 Sep 2026) and EuroLeague/cup game photos (24 and 27 Sep 2026).

source.name: Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.: משחקים בשביל הסמל: המדים הצהובים החדשים
source.quote: מכבי Rapyd תל אביב חושפת עם adidas את סט המדים המוביל
source.note: The Rapyd wordmark sits on the lower front of the left leg of the shorts, above the adidas mark, in the club's launch photos for this kit (23 Sep 2026).

source.name: Maccabi Tel Aviv B.C.: משחקים בשביל הסמל: המדים הצהובים החדשים
source.quote: מכבי Rapyd תל אביב חושפת עם adidas את סט המדים המוביל
source.note: Kit maker: adidas mark on the right chest of the jersey and on the shorts, three stripes down the sides of both. adidas has made Maccabi's kits since 2025/26.

summary: Rapyd is on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey (under the chest number) and on the front of the shorts; adidas is the kit maker. Sleeveless jersey. Not complete: the back of the jersey could not be checked — the official shop is Cloudflare-blocked for scripts, and the club's launch photos, the reveal post on Telegram and the game photos consulted (ASVEL away, 24 Sep; Winner Cup quarter-final, 27 Sep) show fronts only. The EuroLeague/Etihad chest patch (EuroLeague games) and the 'ליגת Winner' chest patch (domestic games) are competition marks, not club sponsors.
